# MyGravelGuy.com

> Nationwide bulk landscape materials delivery marketplace. Order gravel, sand, topsoil, mulch, crushed stone, and more online with instant delivered pricing.

## About

MyGravelGuy connects customers (homeowners and contractors) with local quarries and suppliers to deliver bulk landscape materials directly to their jobsite or property. We serve all 50 states with 33,700+ ZIP codes in our delivery network.

**Business Model**: Online ordering with instant pricing, supplier sourcing, and delivery coordination. One point of contact for bulk material delivery anywhere in the US.

**Tagline**: "Do You Have a Gravel Guy?"

## Products & Services

We offer 47+ bulk landscape materials across 12 categories:

- **Crushed Stone**: #57 Stone, #67 Stone, #8 Stone, #10 Screenings, Crushed Stone (various sizes)
- **Crushed Gravel**: 3/4", 1.5", 2-3", 3/8" sizes
- **Crushed Concrete**: Recycled concrete aggregate, RCA Blend
- **Driveway Gravel**: Multiple sizes optimized for driveways
- **Natural Gravel**: Drainage rock, pea gravel
- **River Rock**: Decorative 1" and 2-3" sizes
- **Sand**: Beach sand, mason sand, playground sand, washed sand
- **Mulch**: Chocolate brown, jet black, natural brown, red
- **Soil**: Topsoil, compost, loam
- **Dirt**: Clean fill, dirt fill
- **Rock & Stone**: Crusher run, decomposed granite, pea gravel, road base
- **Walkway Gravel**: Decorative sizes for pathways

### Pricing
- Instant delivered pricing based on ZIP code
- Volume discounts on larger orders (exponential pricing curve)
- 3-ton minimum per order
- Free delivery included in every price
- Average order: 16 tons, ~$1,473

### Payment Options
- Full payment via credit card (Stripe)
- $199 refundable deposit option with balance due on delivery
- Custom quotes for large or specialty orders

## Customer Segments

### Homeowners
- DIY driveway, landscaping, patio, drainage projects
- Typical order: 3-10 tons
- Value instant pricing and online ordering convenience

### Contractors (Primary Growth Target)
- Landscapers, general contractors, excavation companies, playground/turf installers
- Key use case: sourcing materials when working outside their normal area
- Typical order: 15-50+ tons
- Value one point of contact for nationwide material sourcing
